title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Catastro - CadastralConstruction
description: Building or construction registered on a cadastral property: area, use, construction characteristics, and renovations (edintcat:CadastralConstruction, subclass of geosparql:Feature). Located on exactly one cadastral property.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CadastralConstruction'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

onCadastralProperty.description: Relationship. The CadastralProperty this construction is located on (edintcat:onCadastralProperty).

hasUse.description: Property. Primary use of the construction, from the Uso controlled vocabulary (edintcat:hasUse).

hasRenovation.description: Relationship. Renovation event(s) this construction has undergone (edintcat:hasRenovation).

constructionYear.description: Property. Year the building was constructed (edintcat:constructionYear), xsd:gYear, e.g. '2012'.

staircase.description: Property. Staircase identifier for the construction unit within a building (edintcat:staircase).

floor.description: Property. Floor level identifier, can include basement levels like '-1', '-2' (edintcat:floor).

door.description: Property. Door or unit identifier within a floor and staircase (edintcat:door).

supportPercentage.description: Property. Percentage of the construction area considered support area / common elements (edintcat:supportPercentage).

hasGeometry.description: Relationship. Reference to the construction's geometry, typically carrying its area (geosparql:hasGeometry); see CadastralParcel.hasGeometry for the modeling rationale.
